privacyPolicy.accountDataYourEmail: Account data: your email address and a hashed password. We never store your password in plain text.
privacyPolicy.profileAndGoalsYour: Profile and goals: your first name, timezone, onboarding answers across the five pillars, dream body description, dream personality traits, career goal, and spiritual practice details you choose to share.
privacyPolicy.imagesTheOptionalSelfie: Images: the optional selfie you upload during onboarding and the AI generated future self portrait created from it.
privacyPolicy.activityDataYourQuests: Activity data: your quests, completions, skips, XP, levels, streaks, achievements, daily scores, and weekly reports.
privacyPolicy.conversationDataTheMessages: Conversation data: the messages you exchange with the AI coach, limited to the most recent history needed to keep the conversation coherent.
privacyPolicy.deviceDataAPush: Device data: a push notification token and platform identifier, only if you enable notifications.
privacyPolicy.n2HowTheAi: 2. How the AI coach processes your data
privacyPolicy.coachResponsesAreGenerated: Coach responses are generated by a large language model that runs on our own servers, not by a third party AI provider. When you send a message, the app sends the message text plus a small context block containing your level, daily score, streak, and pillar scores. The model uses this context to reply as your future self.
privacyPolicy.yourChatContentIs: Your chat content is not used to train shared models and is not sent to external AI services. Logs reference your account by an internal identifier only, never by name or email.
privacyPolicy.avatarGenerationSendsYour: Avatar generation sends your onboarding answers and, if you provided one, your selfie to our image generation provider solely to create your portrait. The selfie is stored until you delete your account or ask us to remove it.
privacyPolicy.weDoNotSell: We do not sell your data. We do not run advertising. We do not use third party behavioral trackers. We do not share your spiritual practice details, goals, or conversations with marketers, data brokers, or social networks.
privacyPolicy.dataIsEncryptedIn: Data is encrypted in transit using TLS and at rest on our servers. Passwords are hashed with bcrypt. Access tokens expire after 24 hours and refresh tokens rotate on each use.
privacyPolicy.backupsRunDailyAnd: Backups run daily and are retained for disaster recovery. Deleted account data is purged from live systems promptly and from backups on their normal rotation cycle.
privacyPolicy.exportYouCanRequest: Export: you can request a copy of everything we hold about you from the Profile screen using Export my data. The export includes your profile, goals, quest history, scores, achievements, and conversations.
privacyPolicy.correctionMostProfileFields: Correction: most profile fields can be updated by contacting support. Your timezone and notification preferences are editable in the app.
privacyPolicy.deletionYouCanDelete: Deletion: you can delete your account from the Profile screen. Deletion cascades through all data tied to your account, including images and conversations, and cannot be undone.
privacyPolicy.objectionAndRestrictionYou: Objection and restriction: you may ask us to stop processing optional data, such as your selfie, while keeping your account. Contact privacy@prayerlock.app.
privacyPolicy.pushAndEmailNotifications: Push and email notifications are optional and can be disabled per type in Notification Settings. We send at most 3 notifications per day, only between 08:00 and 22:00 in your timezone, and never during your quiet hours.
privacyPolicy.theServiceIsNot: The service is not directed at children under 16. If we learn that a child under 16 has created an account, we will delete it.
privacyPolicy.ifThisPolicyChanges: If this policy changes materially, we will notify you in the app before the change takes effect. The current version is always available in the app under Profile.

termsOfService.theseTermsOfService: These Terms of Service govern your use of GROW: Prayer and Habits, a mobile application that helps you build habits across five life pillars through daily quests, an AI generated future self portrait, and a conversational coach.
termsOfService.byCreatingAnAccount: By creating an account or using the app, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the app. You must be at least 16 years old, or the age of digital consent in your country, whichever is higher.
termsOfService.youAreResponsibleFor: You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for all activity under your account. You agree to provide an accurate email address so we can verify your account and deliver essential service messages.
termsOfService.youMayDeleteYour: You may delete your account at any time from the Profile screen. Deletion is permanent and removes your profile, goals, quest history, streaks, achievements, and conversations.
termsOfService.growProvidesDailyQuests: GROW provides daily quests, experience points, levels, streaks, achievement badges, analytics, and an AI coach that speaks as your future self. These features exist to support personal habit building.
termsOfService.theAiCoachIs: The AI coach is a motivational tool. It is not a medical, psychological, legal, or financial advisor, and its messages do not constitute professional advice. If you face a health or mental health concern, consult a qualified professional.
termsOfService.spiritualContentInThe: Spiritual content in the app, including prayer quests and practice reminders, is a scheduling aid only. You remain responsible for your own religious observance.
termsOfService.youAgreeNotTo: You agree not to misuse the service. This includes attempting to access another user's account, interfering with the API, scraping or reverse engineering the service, uploading images you do not have the right to use, and submitting unlawful or abusive content.
termsOfService.selfiesYouUploadMust: Selfies you upload must be photos of yourself or photos you have permission to use. You keep ownership of your content. You grant us a limited license to process it solely to operate the service, including generating your future self portrait.
termsOfService.yourFutureSelfPortrait: Your future self portrait is generated by an AI image model from your onboarding answers and, optionally, your selfie. Quests suggested by the coach and messages in chat are generated by a language model. Generated content may occasionally be inaccurate or unexpected.
termsOfService.weReviewAndConstrain: We review and constrain generated content, but we do not guarantee it will always be appropriate for every user. Report problems through the support contact below.
termsOfService.weAimForHigh: We aim for high availability but do not guarantee uninterrupted service. Features may change over time. If we make material changes to these terms, we will notify you in the app before they take effect, and the updated terms will include a new effective date.
termsOfService.questDataScoresAnd: Quest data, scores, and streaks are computed in your local timezone. Day boundaries follow the timezone set on your profile.
termsOfService.theServiceIsProvided: The service is provided as is, without warranties of any kind, express or implied, including fitness for a particular purpose. We do not warrant that habit tracking will produce any particular life outcome.
termsOfService.toTheMaximumExtent: To the maximum extent permitted by law, GROW and its operators are not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the service. Our total liability for any claim is limited to the amount you paid us in the twelve months before the claim, or zero if you paid nothing.
termsOfService.weMaySuspendOr: We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms. You may stop using the service at any time. Sections that by their nature survive termination, including disclaimers and liability limits, survive.
termsOfService.questionsAboutTheseTerms: Questions about these terms can be sent to legal@prayerlock.app.
